subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers sponsor a fresh narrow Feishu URL-boundary fix for this issue, adopt one existing fork attempt, or wait for the broader native-Markdown PR to be split/approved?
rationale: The bug is valid and small, but previous same-repository fixes are closed, fork candidates conflict, and the only open same-repository related PR is broader and blocked on compatibility/proof.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh narrow fix
options.body: Queue or hand-author one Feishu plugin-local fix for underscore-containing bare URLs, using prior branches only as reference and requiring focused tests plus live Feishu proof.

options.title: Adopt an existing fork attempt
options.body: Pick one fork candidate, resolve conflicts in a maintainer-controlled branch, and require the same regression and live-rendering proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for broader Markdown direction
options.body: Keep this issue blocked on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/93940 only if maintainers intentionally accept that PR's outbound compatibility direction or split it down to this bug.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh narrow fix
recommendation.body: Queue or hand-author one Feishu plugin-local fix for underscore-containing bare URLs, using prior branches only as reference and requiring focused tests plus live Feishu proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent live history shows the strongest direct ownership signal on Feishu send-path compatibility and release-adjacent package work.
